---
description: Run a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on a page or component, fixing what's safe to fix directly
agent: accessibility-auditor
---

Audit ${input:target} against WCAG 2.1 AA: semantic structure, keyboard navigation, forms/labels, ARIA usage, color contrast, focus management. Apply direct fixes for labels/alt text/semantic tags/focus-visible styles. Flag anything needing a design decision (contrast, structural rework) rather than guessing.
